remarks: This Forbes Capretto To-Be-Built home is an example of what can be built on the most private remaining site in Cannon Woods. Fresh paint, newly installed flooring, and carefully crafted cabinetry and trim create a bright, polished interior, giving the home a warm and welcoming feel from the moment you enter. The Crestwood floorplan offers nearly 3,000 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, with an open layout that seamlessly connects the great room, kitchen, and dining area — perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. A formal dining room and a versatile flex room off the foyer provide additional space that can easily serve as a home office, hobby room, or play area. Upstairs, all four bedrooms are complete, including the spacious primary suite featuring a private bath retreat and walk-in closet. Interior photos do not depict actual home. Other plans are available.
